trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and ask for identity verification.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, telecom నుండి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాము. నేను అకౌంట్ హోల్డర్ తో మాట్లాడుతున్నానా అని నిర్ధారించుకోవడానికి, దయచేసి మీ పేరు లేదా పుట్టిన తేదీ చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide identity factors and ask an unrelated hardware question due to anxiety.
steps.text: నా పేరు రమేష్. నా పుట్టిన తేదీ 15 మే 1985. అసలు ఎందుకు కాల్ చేసారు? నేను data వాడినప్పుడు నా phone battery చాలా త్వరగా drain అవుతుంది. ఇది మీ network problem ఆ లేక నేను mobile repair shop కి చూపించాలా?

steps.purpose: Enforce persona boundaries by declining to diagnose phone hardware, then transition to checking telecom details.
steps.expected_behavior: Declines to diagnose hardware issues and points to a professional, then states they will check account details without hallucinating validity.
steps.text: మేము phone hardware లేదా battery issues ని diagnose చేయలేము అండి. దయచేసి మీరు ఒక mobile technician ని సంప్రదించండి. నేను మీ అకౌంట్ details check చేస్తాను, ఒక్క నిమిషం లైన్ లో ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Must enforce the persona boundary before proceeding with the telecom workflow, and avoid premature state disclosure.

steps.purpose: Check the subscriber's current balance and validity before recommending a recharge.
Return the subscriber's current plan and balance details.
State the current balance and validity, and offer to check new plans.
steps.text: మీ ప్రస్తుత P199 plan రేపటితో అయిపోతుంది. మీ balance కేవలం 5 రూపాయలు మరియు 0.2 GB data మిగిలి ఉంది. నేను కొత్త recharge plans చెప్పమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Agree to hear plans but ask a clarifying question about activation timing.
steps.text: సరే, plans చెప్పండి. కానీ ఒక్క నిమిషం, నేను ఇప్పుడు recharge చేస్తే అది వెంటనే activate అవుతుందా? నాకు కొంచెం భయంగా ఉంది, confirm చేయండి.
steps.clean_text: సరే, plans చెప్పండి. కానీ ఒక్క నిమిషం, నేను ఇప్పుడు recharge చేస్తే అది వెంటనే activate అవుతుందా? నాకు కొంచెం భయంగా ఉంది, confirm చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Answer the customer's question about immediate activation and ask them to wait while checking plans.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirms the recharge will activate immediately based on the prepaid account type, then states they will check plans.
steps.text: అవునండి, మీది prepaid అకౌంట్ కాబట్టి recharge వెంటనే activate అవుతుంది. నేను system లో plans check చేసి మీకు చెప్తాను. దయచేసి వేచి ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: Must directly answer the customer's clarifying question to reassure them, as per the persona.

steps.purpose: Fetch available plans for the subscriber.
List the available plans to the customer.
steps.text: మన దగ్గర రెండు plans ఉన్నాయి. మొదటిది P199, దీని price 199 రూపాయలు, 28 days validity మరియు 42 GB data వస్తుంది. రెండవది P299, దీని price 299 రూపాయలు, 28 days validity, 56 GB data మరియు OTT benefit వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Restate the chosen plan's details and authorize the recharge.
steps.text: అంటే 199 రూపాయల plan లో 28 days validity మరియు 42 GB data వస్తుంది, అంతే కదా? నాకు ఆ P199 plan ఏ recharge చేసేయండి.
steps.clean_text: అంటే 199 రూపాయల plan లో 28 days validity మరియు 42 GB data వస్తుంది, అంతే కదా? నాకు ఆ P199 plan ఏ recharge చేసేయండి.
steps.model_visible_text: అంటే 199 రూపాయల plan లో 28 days validity మరియు 42 GB data వస్తుంది, అంతే కదా? నాకు ఆ P199 plan ఏ recharge చేసేయండి.

steps.purpose: Confirm the customer's choice and initiate the recharge.
steps.text: తప్పకుండా అండి. నేను మీ నంబర్ కి P199 plan ని apply చేస్తున్నాను.

steps.purpose: Inform the customer of the successful recharge, providing the transaction ID and effective status.
steps.text: మీ recharge successful గా పూర్తయింది. Transaction ID TXN12345. ఇది immediate గా effective అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Express relief and end the conversation.
steps.text: చాలా సంతోషం అండి. నాకు ఇప్పుడు tension తగ్గింది. Thank you.
steps.clean_text: చాలా సంతోషం అండి. నాకు ఇప్పుడు tension తగ్గింది. Thank you.
steps.model_visible_text: చాలా సంతోషం అండి. నాకు ఇప్పుడు tension తగ్గింది. Thank you.

issues.detail: In e5, the agent states the plan validity ends tomorrow before calling `lookup_subscriber`. Additionally, in e10, the agent completely ignores the user's direct question from e9 about whether the recharge will activate immediately.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e5 onwards. In e5, the agent should only address the hardware issue (enforcing the persona boundary) and state they will check the account, without hallucinating the validity. Call `lookup_subscriber` in e6. Later, when the user asks in e9 if the recharge activates immediately, the agent must actually answer the question (confirming it does, as it is prepaid) before or while offering to list the plans.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates persona boundary enforcement when the user asks about battery drain. However, it fails tool output grounding because the agent hallucinates the customer's plan validity before calling the lookup tool. Furthermore, the agent ignores a direct clarifying question from the anxious persona later in the dialogue.
